lines: Let's make a PowerPoint presentation in seven easy steps, from a blank slide to a finished video.

Step one. Open PowerPoint, go to File, then New, and click Blank Presentation. Your first slide is a title slide. Click the box that says, click to add title, and type your title. Then add a subtitle underneath.
Step two: pick a theme. Open the Design tab, and choose a theme from the gallery. Then use Variants to try different colours. Every slide updates at once.
Step three: add slides. On the Home tab, click the arrow under New Slide, and pick a layout. Title and Content works for most slides.

Step four: add your text. Click into the title box and type. Then click the body box and type your points, pressing Enter for each new bullet. Keep it short: three to five bullets, about six words each.
Step five: add visuals. Go to Insert, then Icons, search, pick one, and click Insert. For numbers, use Insert, then Chart. One strong visual per slide is enough.
Step six: transitions and animations. On the Transitions tab, choose Fade, and click Apply To All. Then select your text, open Animations, and choose Fade, so your bullets appear one at a time.
Step seven: present. Practise first with Rehearse with Coach, on the Slide Show tab. When you're ready, click From Beginning, or press F five. Click to move forward, and press Escape to finish.
Bonus: turn it into a video. Go to File, Export, Create a Video. Choose Full HD, click Create Video, and save it as an M P 4. To add your voice, record your narration first.
That's it! Now open PowerPoint, and make yours.
